stem.text: Which two-step process converts cyclohexanol into cyclohexane-1,2-diol?

stem.alt: Reaction scheme: cyclohexanol (a cyclohexane ring with one OH group) with an arrow to cyclohexane-1,2-diol (a cyclohexane ring with OH groups on two adjacent carbons).

A.text: heat strongly with $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$; add cold dilute $\text{KMnO}_4$ and $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$

B.text: heat strongly with $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$; heat with steam and $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$

C.text: reflux with ethanolic NaOH; add cold dilute $\text{KMnO}_4$ and $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$

D.text: reflux with ethanolic NaOH; heat with steam and $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$
